people.name: Anathoth
people.line: A Levitical city in Benjamin, home of the prophet Jeremiah.

translations.web: There will be no remnant to them, for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.’ ”
translations.bsb: There will be no remnant, for I will bring disaster on the people of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.”
translations.kjv: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
